callouts.text: The top bar — start a new mashup, open or save one, add songs, and write the finished file out.
Transport — play and stop, the position clock, the project BPM everything gets matched to, and a button to drop the loop you set on the ruler.
Master — the two thin bars are the output level. Keep them out of the top; the slider beside them turns the whole mix down.
The ruler — click to jump the playhead anywhere. Drag along it to mark a loop and Benchmix plays that section over and over.
One track's controls — a channel strip. Every song you add gets its own, stacked down the left.
The timeline — each song is a block you can drag left or right to line it up with the other.
